name: gate
description: Run the project's deterministic gates and get back pass/fail with the failing output. WHEN TO USE: after you change source, to check your own work the way the improvement engine does — before you report a change as done. WHEN NOT TO USE: not for reading code (use read_file or search_code) and not for running arbitrary commands (use git for git). Input: {} runs build, tools and test in that order; {"gates": ["fmt"]} runs only what you name (build | tools | test | fmt). Returns {"ok": false, "error": "<gate> failed", "text": "<tail of the output>"} on the first failure.

gates.description: Which gates to run, in order. Defaults to build, tools, test.
